<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042024-08-2914-22-286" status="unreviewed">'di'i lan la mtha' rnams bska ba ga sungs nas 'chos gzhi dang ni | gzhan dang ni tshon gyi chos zhes spyod pa la brtens bsgrub bya'i chen kho na pa mi yod te dpe'i chon 3 po la dang po yir te shon gyi sa bon pa yis de des pa dang
        
            <lb n="73b1"/>rjes pa dpag byas pa yod ces brjod pa la brtens kyang cho rjes su pag bya kha na la mi po ste <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">chos rje</rs>s dud pa ba dang shad don rjes su pa bya lang po pir rjes su pa bya'i sa byang b kyi zhe na dang rjes su dang bya la yod ces brjod pa la bsten pa nyes pa dpa' bo de chon kho na la gog pa yin gyi
            <lb n="73b2"/>sgras byag mo ba'i rgyun gnas skabs kyi nges pa yod pir phyogs kyi 'brel pa gtan la 'babs pa'i gnas skabsu phogs kyi sgro de bsgrub ba'i chon kho na la 'jug pir | </seg></TEI>
